시편 146:1.content: Praise ye the Lord. Praise the Lord, O my soul.

시편 146:2.content: While I live will I praise the Lord: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

시편 146:3.content: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

시편 146:4.content: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

시편 146:5.content: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the Lord his God:

시편 146:6.content: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:

시편 146:7.content: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The Lord looseth the prisoners:

시편 146:8.content: The Lord openeth the eyes of the blind: the Lord raiseth them that are bowed down: the Lord loveth the righteous:

시편 146:9.content: The Lord preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

시편 146:10.content: The Lord shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the Lord.
